title: Qatari Prime Minister Travels to Tehran as Iran War Nears Six-Month Mark
summary: Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani has been a key mediator in the conflict, even as his country has blamed Tehran for hundreds of missile and drone attacks.
